purpose: Authored lifecycle and qualified relationship diagrams, not final screen/prototype inventories. Section/object/relation identifiers are local diagram keys; anchors are existing authored scene IDs only.

sources.U: Direct Round05 assignment: version-specific required inputs; Manual offers Factory/CI in run review; automatic bindings fix one target/owner. Integration correction: both manual target alternatives retain Review change v1; Diagnose CI is a separate catalog input profile.

legend.text: EXISTING NATIVE · grey. Source-grounded primitive, not proof that the complete proposed journey exists. Solid arrow = source-supported relation.
EXISTING LOCAL CANDIDATE · blue. Retained Work projection at 3a4ef2e4 only; not shipped-current proof or an ancestor of the inspected checkout.
PROPOSED · amber dashed arrow. #63 planning / AB:66 workflow, invocation and evidence contract. Text names the proposal and scope; dashed never means implemented.
HELD / UNRESOLVED · red. No connector across an unknown adapter relation. A red stop block replaces the arrow; cardinality/enforcement remain unresolved.
CONDITIONAL FUTURE · amber, explicitly labelled. Separate read-only records assuming missing capabilities; not an available path or capability promise.

READING · arrowhead gives direction; on-line IDs refer to the full relation text directly below. Repeated object keys are the same concept in a different local lane, not additional records or datasets.

CARDINALITY · counts apply only to the explicitly named subject, fixture or proposed contract. Unspecified inverse/adapter multiplicity is unresolved. FLOW arrows are conceptual obligations, not verified prototype links.

GROUND · B base; E experience; P prototype constraints; C collections; W workflows; T triggers; S source owners; D delivery; O operations; G native baseline; I inspiration research; Q integrated scenes; U assignment and integration correction. Source paths are indexed in spec/diagram-contract.json.

fixturePins: Manual Review change v1 source for either target: ${fixtures.sourceIssue.provider} / ${fixtures.sourceIssue.repository} / issue ${fixtures.sourceIssue.number} / revision ${fixtures.sourceIssue.revision}. Factory alternative: ${fixtures.manualFactoryInvocation}; CI alternative: ${fixtures.manualCIInvocation}; external CI run: ${fixtures.externalCIRun}.
Workflow sourceCommit: ${fixtures.workflowSourceCommit} · Review change v1 definition digest: ${fixtures.versionDigest}.

Separate catalog input profile, not this CI invocation: wf-diagnose-ci v1 · definition digest: ${workflowCatalog.2.digest}. Required: externalRunRef, jobStep, candidateCommit, logEvidence; no sourceRef/planItemRef requirement. Choosing the CI target does not choose this workflow.
Manual full starting/candidate commit: ${fixtures.candidateCommit}. Definition sourceCommit and candidate commit have different roles; neither substitutes for the other.

Automatic source issue ${fixtures.automaticSourceIssue} / ${fixtures.automaticPlanItemId} / ${fixtures.automaticInvocation} uses Implement issue v1 digest ${workflowCatalog.0.digest}; its own full starting commit must resolve. Never borrow the manual candidate or plan.

Conditional manual Factory retained WorkRef: v${fixtures.retainedWorkAfterFactoryAdmission.version} / ${fixtures.retainedWorkAfterFactoryAdmission.environmentId} / ${fixtures.retainedWorkAfterFactoryAdmission.kind} / ${fixtures.retainedWorkAfterFactoryAdmission.id}; native ThreadId ${fixtures.nativeThreadAfterFactoryAdmission} is a separate typed identity even when its string matches.
qualifications: All values are illustrative. No runtime, accessibility, mobile parity, source-license clearance, provider execution, CI execution or host activation is established by these diagrams.

CURRENT delivery is Held: proposed server guard, implemented threadless delivery-subject adapter and live-base-through-write enforcement are missing. Conditional future records do not change that status. No autonomous, batch or ordered merge queue; no merge-to-release implication.

Required fields come from the pinned workflow version. Review change and Implement issue require sourceRef + project-qualified planItemRef + candidateCommit. Diagnose CI failure v1 requires externalRunRef + jobStep + candidateCommit + logEvidence, with no invented sourceRef/planItemRef requirements. All required fields of the chosen version must resolve before dispatch; unknown/missing/mismatched inputs hold.

The integrated automatic example resolves issue238 rev1, qualified plan-238 and its independently captured full candidateCommit BEFORE dispatch. Raw trigger slice notes predate that repair. No manual-input fallback; the plan requirement belongs to Implement issue, not to every workflow.

Manual is an entry offering Factory or CI; the choice and execution owner are resolved in run review. An automatic binding fixes one target/dispatch owner. Every resulting invocation has exactly one chosen target and owner, regardless of entry type.

Raw T/W files contain historical activation/off snapshots. The lifecycle below states the required draft → review → explicit activation semantics; it does not assert the final integrated prototype implements them. Parent verifies state-preserving returns and actual reachable controls.

Only stable authored anchors are cited. Final scene aliases, frame/edge totals, canvas placements and native node links belong to the parent after integration/import. No live workspace_graph.py was read or changed.

shell.title: T3 project / thread sidebar
shell.body: Keep Search, project/thread cards, Working/Settled, breadcrumb, ordinary timeline/composer and contextual panels. Project Work / Intake / Workflows extends this shell.

source-review.title: Intake · review source revision
source-review.body: Review the incoming source and any canonical match. Own-forge Issues, human Briefs, sealed Research and checkout RSS/Atom retain separate owners and lifecycles.

plan.title: Project-qualified PlanItemRef
plan.body: ${fixtures.planItem.environmentId} / ${fixtures.planItem.projectId} / ${fixtures.planItem.id}. Add to plan starts nothing and creates no retained WorkRef or native thread. Planning stage is independent of source/execution status.

projections.title: Work · Board / Table / List
projections.body: One project/environment query, filter and complete selected identity, rendered three ways. Preserve the origin through source review, target switch and Cancel. Stage changes have an explicit reverse.

initialize.title: Optional project workflow initialization
initialize.body: Review repository, templates, guidance, validation, targets and actual configuration diff. Initialization saves reviewed local configuration only; automation defaults disabled and no run starts.

native-setup.title: t3.json setup / Scheduled Tasks
native-setup.body: Project setup hooks are not portable workflow initialization. Existing Scheduled Tasks own scheduled prompts; Run now dispatches once without enabling. A webhook has no Run now. Do not add a second scheduler.

local-save.title: Saved locally · CI still pending
local-save.body: Local save is not commit, push or observed host activation. Read subsequent external observations as separate records. Configuration navigation never manufactures Git or host actions.

host-active.title: Committed / pushed / host observed
host-active.body: Platform-owned CI becomes eligible only after the host observes the intended committed/pushed configuration. Its native event processing does not need a T3 daemon tick. T3 pause cannot disable that independent host rule.

definition.title: Project workflow definition
definition.body: Project-owned reusable definition. Review change, Implement issue and Diagnose CI failure are illustrative catalog entries. They do not establish a fixed trigger-binding count or an imported executable DAG.

version.title: Immutable version · sourceCommit + digest
version.body: Version pins the workflow definition bytes and source commit. Existing invocation pins never retarget when a draft/version changes. Mutable trigger activation state is not a field of the immutable definition.

candidate.title: Resolved starting / candidate commit
candidate.body: Full candidate commit must resolve in the qualified project/repository. This is distinct from workflow sourceCommit and definition digest. Missing, mismatched or unknown input holds; never substitute selected plan-237 or its manual candidate.

binding.title: Version-bound automatic binding
binding.body: Configure automatic source, filters and version-specific input mapping. Fix one target and one dispatch owner per automatic binding; pin one workflow version. Manual chooses Factory or CI in run review instead. Binding count is not fixed by templates.

activation.title: Review inputs / effects → explicit activation
activation.body: Draft/off → review qualified mapped inputs, target and one owner → explicit activation. Enabled creates no invocation by itself. Manual remains independent; source match or enablement grants no merge/release authority.

trigger-sources.title: Manual entry + automatic sources
trigger-sources.body: Manual offers Factory or CI, chosen in run review. Automatic sources: schedule; platform-native new issue, PR-status or CI-job-status; integration; custom event; authenticated custom webhook. Each automatic binding fixes its target/owner; no fixed three-event enum.

qualified-inputs.title: Resolve the chosen version's required inputs
qualified-inputs.body:
Review change / Implement issue: sourceRef + project-qualified planItemRef + candidateCommit.
Diagnose CI failure v1: externalRunRef + jobStep + candidateCommit + logEvidence; no sourceRef/planItemRef requirement.
All required fields must resolve before dispatch. Check permissions, target and owner; unknown/mismatch holds without fallback.

manual.title: Manual entry · choose target in run review
manual.body: Manual offers Factory or CI; run review chooses one target and owner while preserving the reviewed workflow/version and its required inputs. Both illustrated alternatives use Review change v1 / issue237. Choosing CI does not switch to the Diagnose CI catalog profile. Preserve origin on switch/Cancel.

factory-admission.title: Factory explicit admission / launch
factory-admission.basisLabel: PROPOSED AB:66 over native launch seam
factory-admission.body: Only this reviewed Factory path admits or links retained native Work/thread. Manual inv-f5-factory-01 uses the illustrative root 8b42f1d3. Accepted dispatch is not observed provider start, completion or acceptance.

thread.title: Native ThreadId · ordinary conversation
thread.body: Ordinary timeline/composer, provider approvals/questions and contextual panels. A thread is not a SourceRef, PlanItemRef, WorkRef or invocation. The manual Factory fixture's thread exists only after its explicit admission path.

ci-invocation.title: CI invocation · Review change v1
ci-invocation.body: ${fixtures.manualCIInvocation} runs Review change v1 through CI with sourceRef, qualified planItemRef and candidateCommit resolved. It retains the reviewed definition digest/sourceCommit. No retained WorkRef/native thread is created. Exactly one chosen target/owner; generic adapter association/enforcement remains unresolved.

ci-run.title: External CI run / observed receipt
ci-run.body: Illustrative external run ${fixtures.externalCIRun}: queued and later completed are distinct observations. Host run ID is never a native ThreadId. Successful completion still requires qualified findings/evidence and human decisions.

event.title: Qualified event / occurrence
event.body: Authenticate source where applicable; apply project filter, echo suppression, dedupe and input mapping. Retain matched, filtered, rejected, duplicate and held history. A schedule occurrence or delivered event is data, not broader authority.

auto-inputs.title: Automatic issue238 · separate qualified input
auto-inputs.body: Source issue238 rev1 and env-ws/project-factory/plan-238 belong to Implement issue v1. The integrated accepted example records its own resolved full starting commit and input snapshot before dispatch. Sharing a literal SHA with another example is not shared provenance or a fallback.

auto-invocation.title: One automatic invocation · issue238
auto-invocation.body: ${fixtures.automaticInvocation} is distinct from the manual Factory/CI Review change alternatives. Its provider/thread association is not observed. Never borrow root8b42f1d3, CI run19541, the manual Review change digest or manual evidence.

invocation.title: Owned InvocationRef
invocation.body: One reviewed version, resolved input bundle, selected target and execution owner per admitted invocation. Capture request/event identity and observed receipts separately. Exact adapter association and dedupe enforcement need implementation evidence.

receipt.title: Receipt / invocation history
receipt.body: Retain exact invocation, version, candidate, owner, target, source occurrence and observation scope. Accepted, provider working, external completion, findings, acceptance and confirmed delivery remain separate records.

findings.title: Qualified findings / exact-head dispositions
findings.body: Retain finding identity, producer, subject head and scope. Disposition appends at the exact head; a changed head requires reassessment. Host conversation resolution and local disposition are distinct. Unknown requiredness or coverage holds.
ground: D · append-only review and changed head

evidence.title: Independent evidence / reviewer identity
evidence.body: Pin subject head/base/tree, full changed scope, configuration and receipt provenance. Separate Factory proof, agent corroboration and external observation. Independent reviewer identity and complete coverage cannot be inferred from success or a filtered result.

acceptance.title: Human candidate acceptance
acceptance.body: A person accepts exactly the reviewed candidate head after qualified evidence. This is not a merge grant. Threadless CI acceptance is a proposed subject contract, not fabricated native FactoryAcceptance on a claimed thread.

prepare-held.title: CURRENT prepare · Held
prepare-held.body: Missing server guard, implemented threadless delivery-subject adapter and live-base-through-write enforcement. A disabled control or a read-before-write check is not server enforcement. No current delivery is authorized.

future-prepare.title: Conditional future · prepared payload
future-prepare.body: Read-only design record assuming implemented subject/guard/adapter prerequisites. Pin one repository/PR, exact candidate head, live base, method, policy and payload. Current branch remains Held.

future-grant.title: Conditional future · separate human grant
future-grant.body: Separate human authority names one head/base/method/payload-pinned delivery. Acceptance, evidence, event matching and workflow activation confer no grant. No batching, ordering, automatic merge, tag or release.

future-receipt.title: Conditional future · confirmed receipt
future-receipt.body: Confirm the exact authorized write/result. Unknown delivery requires reconciliation, never blind resend or ownership release. No return reopens an action-ready pregrant record. No release authority follows a merge receipt.

capacity.title: Pause / cap / expiry · future admissions
capacity.body: The independent ops-timer-study limits new admissions only. Pause has explicit resume and preserves history, window and immutable definition. Manual runs and independently owned host rules remain separate. Cancellation is a different request.

writer.title: Unknown writer · ownership retained
writer.body: Remote owner/run/epoch stays owned while outcome is unknown. Timeout, reconnect, pause, cap or stoppedThere bookkeeping does not release ownership or authorize replacement. This is a separate operations fixture.

stop-request.title: Scoped cancellation request
stop-request.body: Explicit scoped stop records its request identity. It does not acknowledge itself, establish a fence or release the writer. No return to an earlier actionable request; later acknowledgement is an external observation.

fenced.title: Matched acknowledgement + write fence
fenced.body: Match owner, invocation/thread/run, request and writer epoch; establish a fence rejecting the prior writer. Missing or uncertain evidence remains Held. Acknowledgement without enforced fencing is insufficient.

replay.title: Evidence replay · new isolated identity
replay.body: Explicit replay uses a complete pinned snapshot in a new invocation, native thread and isolated worktree. It carries no receipts, acceptance, grants, hosted approval, credentials or schedule enablement. Original ownership/history remains distinct.
ground: O · replay receipt and retained snapshot

environment.title: Environment qualifier
environment.body: ${project.environmentId} / ${project.environmentName}. Environment owns its project records and native execution state. Same repository URL or source key does not imply shared identity across environments.

project.title: Qualified ProjectRef
project.body: ${project.environmentId} / ${project.id}; ${project.repository}. New planning/workflow records must retain both project and environment. Executor location is separate from owning environment.

source.title: SourceRef · source-owned revision
source.body: ${fixtures.sourceIssue.provider} / ${fixtures.sourceIssue.repository} / issue ${fixtures.sourceIssue.number} / revision ${fixtures.sourceIssue.revision}. An unstarted forge issue can be visible without retained Work or thread. Source status is not plan stage.

work.title: Retained WorkRef · admission root
work.body: Version + owning environment + kind + retained root ID. Candidate issue/feed Work projects original native admission roots. Before Factory admission this fixture has none; CI-only and automatic accepted-only fixtures supply no observed association.

native-acceptance.title: Native claimed-thread acceptance
native-acceptance.body: Native Factory acceptance/delivery requires a claimed task thread. Current acceptance is head-bound. This existing seam does not prove that a threadless CI candidate is a valid delivery subject.

delivery-subject.title: Threadless delivery-subject adapter
delivery-subject.body: No implemented subject adapter, cardinality or guard enforcement is established for this CI-only fixture. Retained association is absent. Do not draw a dashed implementation fact or borrow the manual Factory thread.

disposition.title: Finding/head disposition entry
disposition.body: An entry names its exact finding and candidate head, actor, reason/mechanism and supporting evidence. Retain earlier entries. A new head needs a new assessment; host conversation state is not the app disposition.

diagrams.title: F5-FLOW · One native T3 shell · workflow lifecycle and authority boundaries
diagrams.intro: Read each lane in arrow direction. Lanes share named concepts and authored scene anchors; they are not one automatically executing pipeline. Navigation sends nothing. FLOW relations specify lifecycle/return obligations, not final prototype edges. Grey native shell stays; project workspace and portable workflow behavior are proposals.

sections.title: Keep the shell; review the source; plan without execution
sections.note: The native project/thread sidebar is retained around Work / Intake / Workflows. Source-owned review remains reachable through the project menu and contextual review.

relations.label: Open project Intake / source review
relations.cardinality: navigation only; no dataset cardinality
relations.qualification: Keep the complete current project/environment and origin. Opening review sends nothing.

relations.label: Add to plan · nonexecuting
relations.cardinality: this fixture adds plan-237 for reviewed issue237; no global multiplicity claim
relations.qualification: Creates no retained WorkRef/thread, does not claim work, close the forge issue or invoke existing feed Admit and start.

relations.label: Render the same selected query in three layouts
relations.cardinality: one selection/query/project/environment; Board, Table, List are projections
relations.qualification: Preserve identity and filter; stage edit has a reverse and grants no execution/acceptance/delivery authority.

sections.boundary: Native source review, planning, retained admission and execution are separate. No Factory/Sessions replacement shell; no drag-to-start.

sections.title: Optional initialization is separate from native setup and scheduled prompts
sections.note: The first card is a boundary comparison; it has no initialization arrow. Configured returns must not re-offer initialization.

relations.label: Review configuration diff → local save only
relations.cardinality: selected project profile; no run
relations.qualification: No agent, automatic binding or CI execution starts. This is distinct from t3.json setup and the native prompt scheduler.

relations.label: Read later external commit / push / host observation
relations.cardinality: no activation inferred from a save
relations.qualification: Host-owned CI rules require their own observed state. They do not require a T3 daemon tick; T3 pause cannot disable the host rule.

sections.boundary: Local configuration, committed/pushed configuration and observed active host configuration are different records. Native Scheduled Tasks are reused where appropriate; no second scheduler.

sections.title: Automatic bindings · configure → resolve → review → explicitly activate
sections.note: This lane configures automatic bindings, initially Draft/off with one fixed target/dispatch owner. Manual is a separate entry offering Factory or CI, chosen in run review. Automatic sources include schedule, new issue, PR-status, CI-job-status, integration, custom event and authenticated custom webhook.

relations.label: Choose automatic source, filter and version-specific mapping
relations.cardinality: one fixed target/dispatch owner per automatic binding; binding count not fixed
relations.qualification: Pin immutable version. This arrow applies to automatic sources; Manual chooses target/owner in run review. Adapters are source categories, not implied installed capabilities.

relations.label: Preview the pinned version's mapped required inputs
relations.cardinality: all required fields of the chosen version; no global sourceRef/planItemRef requirement
relations.qualification: Review change/Implement issue require sourceRef, planItemRef, candidateCommit. Diagnose CI v1 requires externalRunRef, jobStep, candidateCommit, logEvidence. Missing/mismatch/unknown holds; no manual-input or target fallback.

relations.label: Explicitly approve activation effects
relations.cardinality: activation itself creates no invocation
relations.qualification: Review exactly one owner and target. Host-owned rules additionally require observed committed/pushed configuration. Events and enablement grant no merge/release authority.

sections.boundary: This is the required lifecycle, not a claim that the raw historical trigger scenes provide a final activation path. Parent verifies integrated Draft/off, review, enabled-without-run and later event states.

sections.title: Manual issue237 · explicit Factory path only
sections.note: Manual offers Factory or CI for the same reviewed Review change v1 definition and inputs. This lane chooses Factory; the next lane chooses CI. Diagnose CI is a separate catalog profile, not a side effect of target selection. Target-switch Cancel restores the actual origin.

relations.label: Resolve Review change v1 required inputs
relations.cardinality: one reviewed manual request; one chosen target/owner
relations.qualification: Review change requires sourceRef + project-qualified planItemRef + full candidateCommit. Definition sourceCommit/digest and candidate are independently pinned; this is not the diagnostic input profile.

relations.label: Explicit Run · selected Factory owner
relations.cardinality: one illustrative manual Factory invocation
relations.qualification: Only this admission path links retained native Work/thread; source/plan identity remains unchanged.

relations.label: Read later provider-start observation
relations.cardinality: one root shown for this manual fixture; not universal adapter cardinality
relations.qualification: Dispatch accepted is not provider working. Keep ordinary native timeline/composer and return to the corresponding current collection projection.

sections.boundary: Before admission, source237/plan-237 has no retained Work or native thread. After admission, WorkRef and ThreadId remain distinct even when the fixture strings match.

sections.title: Manual CI review · externally owned; no native thread
sections.note: The integrated W06/W09/W10 example retains Review change v1 and issue237/plan-237. Only the execution target/owner changes. Reading later external completion is not a new dispatch.

relations.label: Choose CI in run review → preserve reviewed inputs → explicit Run
relations.cardinality: one illustrative manual CI invocation with exactly one chosen target/owner
relations.qualification: Review change v1 requires sourceRef, qualified planItemRef and candidateCommit. All must resolve before dispatch; preserve the version digest/sourceCommit. The Diagnose CI catalog contract does not replace these inputs when CI is chosen.

relations.label: Read queued receipt, then later completed observation
relations.cardinality: fixture maps inv-f5-ci-01 to external19541 only; generic multiplicity unresolved
relations.qualification: No native ThreadId/retained Work association exists here. Neither observation is candidate acceptance.

relations.label: Review qualified evidence and findings
relations.cardinality: history remains exact-invocation/exact-head; no aggregate count inferred
relations.qualification: Finished/success is a raw execution conclusion, not a clean verdict. Missing coverage or unknown requiredness holds.

sections.boundary: Factory and CI are alternative fixture executions of Review change v1, not two runs caused by one click. Diagnose CI remains a separate four-input catalog profile. External run19541 never becomes a T3 thread.

sections.title: Automatic issue238 · independent input, occurrence and invocation
sections.note: A later qualified event may dispatch only through its explicitly active binding. Dedupe/echo handling preserves history without creating extra runs.

relations.label: Authenticate / filter / dedupe / map / resolve
relations.cardinality: one source occurrence under its owner-qualified binding; duplicates add no run
relations.qualification: Resolve source238 + project-qualified plan-238 + its full starting commit before dispatch. Unknown values hold; issue237 inputs cannot fill gaps.

relations.label: Active binding admits one owned invocation
relations.cardinality: this matched fixture → inv-f5-auto-01 once; held/filtered/rejected/echo → no new invocation
relations.qualification: Implement issue v1 and source238 stay distinct from manual Review change v1/source237. No observed native association yet.

relations.label: Retain exact dispatch observation and history
relations.cardinality: one invocation identity; later observations do not create a second invocation
relations.qualification: Accepted-only remains accepted-only until actual later evidence. No borrowed manual thread, external run or findings.

sections.boundary: The integrated example captures the automatic source, qualified plan and full candidate before dispatch. This diagram records that contract; it neither resolves repository state nor borrows the manual candidate.

sections.title: Evidence → human acceptance → CURRENT Held
sections.note: This is the current decision boundary. Earlier findings and receipts survive a head move; they are not relabelled as proof for the new head.

relations.label: Append exact-head disposition and independent proof
relations.cardinality: per finding/head; unknown coverage holds
relations.qualification: Complete scope, identity and provenance are required. Reviewer independence is a qualified identity, not a second green badge.

relations.label: Read separately authorized human acceptance
relations.cardinality: one exact candidate head per acceptance record
relations.qualification: Evidence readiness does not accept automatically. This threadless record is not existing claimed-thread FactoryAcceptance.

relations.label: Attempt preparation remains Held
relations.cardinality: no live preparation/grant/confirmed write established
relations.qualification: Missing current guard + threadless delivery subject + live-base-through-write enforcement. Acceptance grants no merge/release.

sections.boundary: No arrow leads from CURRENT Held into future execution. The next lane is a separate conditional record study, not a continuation that clears the hold.

sections.title: Conditional future records only · separate prepare / grant / receipt
sections.note: Assumes capabilities absent today. These arrows read distinct conditional records; they are not action-ready controls or a capability promise.

relations.label: Separate human grant record
relations.cardinality: one candidate / repository / PR / head / live base / method / payload
relations.qualification: Explicit separate authority. No automatic selection, batch, ordered queue, rebase, tag or release grant.

relations.label: Confirmed authorized write readback
relations.cardinality: exact granted subject and payload only
relations.qualification: Must enforce live base through write, then confirm result. Unknown stays owned/reconcile-only. Receipt cannot reopen pregrant actions.

sections.boundary: CURRENT branch remains Held. Confirmed merge is not release approval. Future fictional readback proves no host write.

sections.title: Pause/cap affects new admissions; cancellation preserves uncertain ownership
sections.note: Capacity and remote recovery are separate operations fixtures. There is intentionally no arrow from pause/cap to stopped or to ownership release.

relations.label: Explicit scoped cancellation request
relations.cardinality: one qualified request for the owned writer scope
relations.qualification: Request is not acknowledgement or stopped. Unknown writer remains owned; no replacement by timeout/reconnect.

relations.label: Read later matched acknowledgement + enforced fence
relations.cardinality: exact request / owner / run / writer epoch match
relations.qualification: Both acknowledgement and write fence required. No UI action fabricates the observation; missing either keeps Held.

sections.boundary: Pause has explicit resume; caps constrain only new admissions and retain history. Cancellation is separate and never inferred from parent completion, offline state or stoppedThere.

sections.title: Evidence replay uses a new identity and isolated context
sections.note: This replay is an explicit conditional operations action, not a provider retry, production replacement or reused invocation.

relations.label: Review complete snapshot → explicit evidence-only replay
relations.cardinality: one original link; new invocation/thread/worktree/receipts
relations.qualification: No carried acceptance, grant, hosted approval, credentials or schedule enablement. Missing bytes or uncertain writer holds.

sections.boundary: Replay preserves original history and ownership boundaries. It does not imply a general run pause or autonomous recovery capability.

diagrams.edgeSemantics: Process: step or later observation; independent lanes, no automatic execution.

diagrams.title: F5-DATA · Qualified relationships · identity, evidence and ownership
diagrams.intro: Read object keys as typed concepts. A repeated object is a reference to the same concept, not an extra dataset. Relation text gives the only supported cardinality and its scope. Proposed cardinalities describe the authored contract, not observed runtime enforcement. Unknown adapters are stop blocks with no arrow.

sections.title: Owner-qualified project and plan; source identity remains separate
sections.note: SourceRef ≠ PlanItemRef ≠ retained WorkRef ≠ ThreadId. Shared repository URL, matching string ID or selected UI row cannot collapse these identities.

relations.label: qualifies owning project
relations.cardinality: each ProjectRef includes one owning environment; inverse count not asserted
relations.qualification: Use the environment qualifier on every destination/reference, including remote execution contexts.

relations.label: owns proposed planning identity
relations.cardinality: each PlanItemRef includes one project and one environment
relations.qualification: Planned identity survives later optional execution associations and every Board/Table/List projection.

relations.label: links reviewed source revision; is not that source
relations.cardinality: one source link for plan-237 in this fixture; general multiplicity unresolved
relations.qualification: Source status and ownership stay native. Add to plan does not claim, execute, close or allocate a retained root.

sections.boundary: One selected query feeds Board/Table/List. This diagram does not infer one-to-one global source-to-plan identity or universal TaskId.

sections.title: Conditional Factory association is supported only through explicit admission
sections.note: The blue WorkRef is a local candidate projection, not shipped-current proof. Proposed plan/invocation adapters remain separate from native launch and thread primitives.

relations.label: provides resolved planning input
relations.cardinality: one plan input in this manual fixture; no global invocation multiplicity asserted
relations.qualification: Before admission plan-237 has no retained WorkRef or native thread. Explicit Run is the boundary.

relations.label: links retained admission root
relations.basisLabel: AB:66 association over local Work candidate
relations.cardinality: absent before; one linked WorkRef in this manual Factory fixture
relations.qualification: No blanket Invocation→Work cardinality. Automatic accepted-only fixture has no observed association; CI fixture has none.

relations.label: issue/feed retained id is original admission root
relations.cardinality: one original root for this retained issue/feed identity; not all Work kinds
relations.qualification: A typed WorkRef includes version/environment/kind/id. ThreadId remains a separate type despite the matching fixture string.

sections.boundary: Do not generalize the manual root association into a mandatory thread for every invocation, target or source kind.

sections.title: CI remains threadless; adapter subject relation is unresolved
sections.note: A proposed portable CI invocation is not an existing native thread. No retained association is present in this fixture; do not use the alternative Factory root as a bridge.

relations.label: retains externally observed run association
relations.cardinality: this fixture: inv-f5-ci-01 → external19541; generic adapter multiplicity unresolved
relations.qualification: Native Work associations: none observed in this fixture. Native threads: none. Host owns execution and receipt observations.

relations.label: adapter relation NOT established
relations.cardinality: unknown; no implemented threadless subject cardinality asserted
relations.qualification: No arrow: missing subject adapter and enforcement cannot be promoted into a dashed implementation fact.

sections.boundary: Zero native associations is a fixture fact, not a universal prohibition on a future optional retained link. Its adapter contract/enforcement needs separate evidence.

sections.title: Invocation pins definition version and candidate separately
sections.note: The full fixture hashes are printed in the caption band from base.json. No source commit, candidate SHA or digest is invented or resolved by this generator.

relations.label: pins immutable workflow version
relations.cardinality: one pinned version per admitted invocation
relations.qualification: Version includes sourceCommit and definition digest. Later draft/version changes do not rewrite admitted history or active binding pins.

relations.label: pins separately resolved starting/candidate commit
relations.cardinality: one full resolved candidateCommit per illustrated invocation; other adapter multiplicity not asserted
relations.qualification: Resolve every other required field of the pinned version too: sourceRef/planItemRef for Review change and Implement issue; externalRunRef/jobStep/logEvidence for Diagnose CI v1. A corrected head requires new evidence, not relabelled receipts.

sections.boundary: Immutable workflow identity, mutable trigger state and candidate code identity are distinct. No automatic input can default to the manual candidate.

sections.title: Automatic binding fixes version, dispatch owner and target
sections.note: Manual instead offers Factory or CI with the choice made in run review. Both paths produce invocations with exactly one chosen target/owner. Binding counts are intentionally absent; catalog templates do not imply installed adapters.

relations.label: belongs to one definition
relations.cardinality: one definition per immutable version; total versions not fixed
relations.qualification: Editing produces a separately reviewed version. The source commit and digest bind immutable definition bytes.

relations.label: pins one reviewed version and its required input contract
relations.cardinality: one version and one fixed target/dispatch owner per automatic binding; binding count not fixed
relations.qualification: Automatic source/filter/mapping resolves that version's fields. Manual chooses target/owner in run review. Mutable activation state stays on the automatic binding, not the definition.

relations.label: has explicit reviewed activation state
relations.cardinality: one current qualified state per binding snapshot; no invocation created by enablement
relations.qualification: Default disabled; platform-owned configuration requires commit/push/host observation. Native host processing has no T3 tick dependency.

sections.boundary: Initialization is not t3.json setup. Existing scheduled prompt management is not the entire portable definition/binding model; no second scheduler is introduced.

sections.title: Manual request or qualified occurrence → owned invocation → observed receipts
sections.note: The left card is the automatic case with a fixed binding target/owner. Manual is the alternative entry: offer Factory or CI, then choose in run review. Every resulting invocation has exactly one chosen target/owner. No event confers merge/release authority.

relations.label: resolves pinned version's required fields through active binding mapping
relations.cardinality: all required fields of the chosen version per dispatch; sourceRef/planItemRef are not global requirements
relations.qualification: Review change/Implement issue: sourceRef, planItemRef, candidateCommit. Diagnose CI v1: externalRunRef, jobStep, candidateCommit, logEvidence. Authentication, scope, filters, dedupe, echo suppression and permissions also qualify the occurrence. Missing/unknown/mismatch holds.

relations.label: admits under exactly one chosen target / owner
relations.cardinality: qualifying admitted occurrence/request → one invocation with one target/owner; filtered/rejected/held/echo → none; duplicate → no additional invocation
relations.qualification: Manual chooses target/owner in run review; automatic bindings fix them. Issue238 uses its own Implement issue inputs; CI diagnostic uses its own version-specific fields. Exact dedupe/admission enforcement still needs implementation evidence.

relations.label: retains qualified observation history
relations.cardinality: each receipt names one invocation; receipt count/lifecycle depends on adapter
relations.qualification: An admitted invocation may await observation. Accepted, working and completed are separate; a receipt cannot silently change subject/owner/head.

sections.boundary: The diagram specifies desired admission semantics, not transactional or exactly-once implementation proof. Unknown adapter enforcement remains unresolved.

sections.title: Append-only findings, exact-head dispositions and independent evidence
sections.note: Repeated observations stay retained. Same-head rerun, new-head correction and replay are different provenance paths; none overwrites an earlier finding into green.

relations.label: grounds reported finding identity / subject
relations.cardinality: no finding count inferred from run success; explicit finding identities only
relations.qualification: Execution conclusion is separate from verdict. Missing report, incomplete scope or unknown requiredness holds rather than implying no findings.

relations.label: names finding and exact candidate head
relations.cardinality: one finding/head subject per disposition entry; earlier entries retained
relations.qualification: Record actor, mechanism, reason and evidence. New-head reassessment appends; GitHub resolved/open state is separate.

relations.label: is supported by qualified subject-bound proof
relations.cardinality: required evidence set is policy-scoped; unknown completeness holds
relations.qualification: Independent evidence/reviewer identities, exact head/base/tree/config and complete changed scope are inspectable. Model narrative alone is not native or external proof.

sections.boundary: Acceptance is not derived from a success badge, a disappeared finding, filtered review output, or confidence/severity conflation.

sections.title: Existing native acceptance and proposed threadless acceptance differ
sections.note: The native seam is shown for comparison, not as an adapter for this CI fixture. There is no arrow between native and threadless acceptance objects.

relations.label: requires claimed native task thread
relations.cardinality: thread-scoped subject; no generic CI subject mapping asserted
relations.qualification: Head-bound native acceptance cannot be manufactured by attaching the alternative manual Factory thread to CI evidence.

relations.label: does not supply missing preparation capability
relations.cardinality: one accepted head is not a grant or confirmed write
relations.qualification: Current missing guard, threadless subject and live-base-through-write prerequisites remain blocking after human acceptance.

sections.boundary: No implicit Acceptance→Merge authority relation. Current native acceptance does not establish the proposed threadless delivery-subject contract.

sections.title: Single-candidate future preparation / grant / confirmed receipt
sections.note: Reference direction, not execution order: Receipt points to its Grant, and Grant points to its prepared payload. These records are conditional proposals. The guard must cover the actual write, not just UI readiness or a prior base read.

relations.label: authorizes exact prepared delivery payload
relations.cardinality: one candidate/head/base/method/payload subject per grant
relations.qualification: Separate human decision binds repository/PR and reviewed policy. Source event, acceptance and workflow completion grant nothing by themselves.

relations.label: confirms the exact authorized write
relations.cardinality: one authorized delivery subject for this receipt; retry/adapter multiplicity unspecified
relations.qualification: Unknown outcome remains owned/reconcile-only. Confirmed record never reopens action-ready pregrant UI; no batch/ordered/autonomous merge queue or release authority.

sections.boundary: No connection is drawn from the CURRENT Held state into this lane. The fictional confirmed record is not a host observation or capability promise.

sections.title: Admission capacity and active-writer cancellation are different relations
sections.note: Capacity records apply to the independent ops-timer-study. The remote ownership fixture is not a state transition of either manual Review change execution.

relations.label: constrains new admissions for a version-bound binding
relations.cardinality: one binding/control revision and named admission window in this study
relations.qualification: Pause/resume, cap and expiry retain prior history; they do not cancel active work, reset admitted history or disable manual/host-owned rules.

relations.label: targets exact owned writer scope
relations.cardinality: request names owner/run/epoch; no release from request alone
relations.qualification: Unknown owner remains owned. Timeout, reconnect or stoppedThere does not fence writes or permit replacement.

sections.boundary: No binding-pause→writer-stopped edge exists. Cancellation and capacity are independent; remote owner coverage/capabilities remain explicit.

sections.title: Acknowledgement/fence qualifies a separate evidence replay
sections.note: The arrow back to the original is lineage only. Original receipts, authority and ownership are not carried to a new invocation.

relations.label: matches exact original owner/run/request/epoch
relations.cardinality: one exact writer scope per matched acknowledgement/fence record
relations.qualification: Requires enforceable rejection of the prior writer epoch plus matched acknowledgement. Missing either holds; observation is not fabricated by navigation.

relations.label: requires qualified original and complete pinned snapshot
relations.cardinality: one original invocation link; new replay invocation/thread/isolated worktree
relations.qualification: Evidence-only replay creates new receipts and carries no grants, acceptance, hosted approval, credentials or schedule enablement. It is not a provider retry or production replacement.

sections.boundary: Uncertain writers and incomplete snapshots remain Held. Conditional replay records are not shipped recovery or remote-parity claims.

diagrams.edgeSemantics: Reference: record -> referenced record; not lifecycle order.
